text:
sqlpipe copies Postgres tables to Amazon S3 and writes them as Parquet files. Parquet is a column storage format that analytics tools read fast. You point sqlpipe at a database and a bucket, and it moves the tables for you.

You run one command to sync a table, or a schedule to keep the data fresh. sqlpipe reads each table in batches, so it works on large tables without a large amount of memory. It tracks what it copied, so a repeated run moves only the new rows. Use sqlpipe to build a data lake, feed a query engine, or keep a backup of your tables in open formats.
